title: Count Vowels and Consonants
description:
Write a function `count_chars(s)` that returns a tuple `(vowels, consonants)` where:
- `vowels` is the count of vowel characters (a, e, i, o, u — case-insensitive)
- `consonants` is the count of alphabetic characters that are not vowels

Ignore non-alphabetic characters.
hint: Convert to lowercase, iterate, use a set of vowels for O(1) lookup.
outputExplanation: count_chars("Hello World!") counts e,o (2 vowels) and h,l,l,w,r,l,d (7 consonants), returning (2, 7).
